Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Language Infra SubDis.

Fixpoint principal_type (v:exp) : typ :=
  match v with
  | unit => top
  | lit i5 => int
  | box e1 (ann (lam bl e) (arr A B)) => arr A B
  | box e1 (ann (lam wh e) (arr (rcd l A) B)) => arr A B
  | merge v1 v2 => and (principal_type v1) (principal_type v2)
  | rec l v1 => rcd l (principal_type v1)
  | _ => top
  end.

Definition old_dis A B :=
  forall C, sub A C -> sub B C -> toplike C.

Theorem gen_step_unique: forall e m A G,
  has_type G e m A -> forall v e1 e2,
  has_type top v inf G ->
  step v e e1 ->
  step v e e2 ->
  e1 = e2.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Lia.

Inductive typ :=
  | int : typ
  | top : typ
  | and : typ -> typ -> typ
  | rcd : nat -> typ -> typ
  | arr : typ -> typ -> typ.

Inductive mode := inf | chk.

Inductive fmode := bl | wh.

Inductive exp :=
  | lit : nat -> exp
  | unit : exp
  | ctx : exp
  | merge : exp -> exp -> exp
  | ann : exp -> typ -> exp
  | rec : nat -> exp -> exp
  | proj : exp -> nat -> exp
  | lam : fmode -> exp -> exp
  | app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | box : exp -> exp -> exp.

Inductive sub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sint  : sub int int
  | stop  : forall A, sub A top
  | sand  : forall A B C, sub A B -> sub A C -> sub A (and B C)
  | sandl : forall A B C, sub A C -> sub (and A B) C
  | sandr : forall A B C, sub B C -> sub (and A B) C
  | srcd  : forall x A B, sub A B -> sub (rcd x A) (rcd x B)
  | sarr  : forall A B C D, sub C A -> sub B D -> sub (arr A B) (arr C D).

Inductive gord : typ -> Prop :=
  | GO_int :
      gord int
  | GO_arrow : forall A B,
      gord B ->
      gord (arr A B)
  | GO_rcd : forall x B,
      gord B ->
      gord (rcd x B).

Definition cost_spec A B := exists C, gord C /\ sub A C /\ sub B C.

Definition disjoint A B := ~ (cost_spec A B).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | vlit : forall i, value (lit i)
  | vunit : value unit
  | vmrg : forall e1 e2, value e1 -> value e2 -> value (merge e1 e2)
  | vrec : forall x e, value e -> value (rec x e)
  | vclos : forall e1 e A B, value e1 -> value (box e1 (ann (lam bl e) (arr A B)))
  | vsclos : forall e1 e A B l, value e1 -> value (box e1 (ann (lam wh e) (arr (rcd l A) B))).

Inductive genv : typ -> exp -> Prop :=
  | genv_top : genv top unit
  | genv_arr : forall A B v,
      genv B v ->
      genv (arr A B) (box unit (ann (lam bl v) (arr A B)))
  | genv_and : forall A B v1 v2, genv A v1 -> genv B v2 -> genv (and A B) (merge v1 v2)
  | genv_rcd : forall A l v, genv A v -> genv (rcd l A) (rec l v).

Inductive ord : typ -> Prop :=
  | O_int :
      ord int
  | O_arrow : forall A B,
      ord (arr A B)
  | O_rcd : forall x B,
      ord (rcd x B).

Inductive toplike : typ -> Prop :=
  | TL_top :
      toplike top
  | TL_and : forall A B,
      toplike A ->
      toplike B ->
      toplike (and A B)
  | TL_arr : forall (A B:typ),
      toplike B ->
      toplike (arr A B)
  | TL_rcd : forall x (B:typ),
      toplike B ->
      toplike (rcd x B).

Inductive ext : typ -> fmode -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ext_bl: forall A, ext A bl A
  | ext_wh: forall x A, ext (rcd x A) wh A.

Inductive casting : exp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
  | cast_top  : forall v, casting v top unit
  | cast_int  : forall i, casting (lit i) int (lit i)
  | cast_mrgl : forall v1 v2 A v1',
      casting v1 A v1' ->
      ord A ->
      casting (merge v1 v2) A v1'
  | cast_mrgr : forall v1 v2 A v2',
      casting v2 A v2' ->
      ord A ->
      casting (merge v1 v2) A v2'
  | cast_and : forall v v1 v2 A B,
      casting v A v1 ->
      casting v B v2 ->
      casting v (and A B) (merge v1 v2)
  | cast_rcd : forall v A v' x,
      casting v A v' ->
      casting (rec x v) (rcd x A) (rec x v')
  | cast_arr : forall e v A B C D A' fm,
      value v ->
      ~ toplike D ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      sub B D ->
      casting (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) (arr C D) (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A D)))
  | cast_arr_tl : forall e v A B C D v' fm A',
      value v ->
      toplike D ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      sub B D ->
      genv (arr C D) v' ->
      casting (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) (arr C D) v'.

Definition consistencySpec v1 v2 :=
  forall A v1' v2', casting v1 A v1' -> casting v2 A v2' -> v1' = v2'.

Inductive has_type : typ -> exp -> mode -> typ -> Prop :=
  | tlit : forall G i, has_type G (lit i) inf int
  | tunit : forall G, has_type G unit inf top
  | tctx : forall G, has_type G ctx inf G
  | tmrg : forall G e1 e2 A B,
      has_type G e1 inf A ->
      has_type (and G A) e2 inf B ->
      disjoint A B ->
      disjoint G A ->
      has_type G (merge e1 e2) inf (and A B)
  | tcon : forall G v1 v2 A B,
      has_type G v1 inf A ->
      has_type G v2 inf B ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      consistencySpec v1 v2->
      has_type G (merge v1 v2) inf (and A B)
  | tann : forall G e A,
      has_type G e chk A ->
      has_type G (ann e A) inf A
  | tlam : forall A e B G C fm A',
      disjoint G A ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      has_type (and G A) e chk B ->
      has_type G (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)) inf (arr C B)
  | tapp : forall G e1 e2 A B,
      has_type G e1 inf (arr A B) ->
      has_type G e2 chk A ->
      has_type G (app e1 e2) inf B
  | tbox : forall e1 e2 A B G,
      has_type G e1 inf B ->
      has_type B e2 inf A ->
      has_type G (box e1 e2) inf A
  | tsub : forall G e A B,
      has_type G e inf A ->
      sub A B ->
      has_type G e chk B
  | trec : forall G e x A,
      has_type G e inf A ->
      has_type G (rec x e) inf (rcd x A)
  | tproj : forall G e x A,
      has_type G e inf (rcd x A) ->
      has_type G (proj e x) inf A.

Inductive constr : typ -> exp -> fmode -> exp -> Prop :=
  | constr_bl: forall A v, constr A v bl v
  | constr_wh: forall x A v, constr (rcd x A) v wh (rec x v).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=
  | step_ctx : forall v, value v -> step v ctx v
  | step_annv : forall v v1 A v1', value v -> casting v1 A v1' -> value v1 -> step v (ann v1 A) v1'
  | step_anne : forall v e e' A, step v e e' -> step v (ann e A) (ann e' A)
  | step_mrgr : forall v e e' v1, step (merge v v1)  e e' -> value v1 -> step v (merge v1 e) (merge v1 e')
  | step_mrgl : forall v e1 e1' e2, step v e1 e1' -> step v (merge e1 e2) (merge e1' e2)
  | step_rcde : forall v e' e x, step v e e' -> step v (rec x e) (rec x e')
  | step_projv : forall v v1 x, value v -> value v1 -> step v (proj (rec x v1) x) v1
  | step_proje : forall v e' e x, step v e e' -> step v (proj e x) (proj e' x)
  | step_switch : forall v e A B fm,
      value v ->
      step v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)) (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)))
  | step_beta : forall v v1 A B v1' e v2 A' fm v3,
      ext A fm A' ->
      casting v1 A' v1' ->
      value v ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      constr A v1' fm v3 ->
      step v (app (box v2 (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) v1) (box (merge v2 v3) (ann e B))
  | step_appl : forall v e1 e1' e2, step v e1 e1' -> step v (app e1 e2) (app e1' e2)
  | step_appr : forall v v1 e2 e2', step v e2 e2' -> value v1 -> step v (app v1 e2) (app v1 e2')
  | step_boxv : forall v v1 v2, value v -> value v1 -> value v2 -> step v (box v1 v2) v2
  | step_boxe : forall e e' v v1,
      step v1 e e' ->
      value v ->
      ~ value (box v1 e) ->
      step v (box v1 e) (box v1 e')
  | step_boxc : forall e1 e2 v e,
      step v e1 e2 ->
      value v ->
      step v (box e1 e) (box e2 e).

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Lia.

Require Import Language.

Fixpoint size_typ (A1 : typ) {struct A1} : nat :=
  match A1 with
    | int => 1
    | top => 1
    | arr A2 B1 => 1 + (size_typ A2) + (size_typ B1)
    | and A2 B1 => 1 + (size_typ A2) + (size_typ B1)
    | rcd l1 A2 => 1 + (size_typ A2)
  end.

Fixpoint size_exp (e1 : exp) {struct e1} : nat :=
  match e1 with
    | unit => 1
    | lit i1 => 1
    | ctx => 1
    | merge e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | ann e2 A1 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_typ A1)
    | rec l1 e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | proj e2 l1 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | lam fm e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | app e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | box e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
  end.

Definition relation (X:Type) := X -> X -> Prop.

Section Star.

Variable A : Type.

Variable R : relation A.

Inductive star: relation A:=
  | star_refl: forall a,
      star a a
  | star_step: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> star a c.

Hypothesis R_functional:
  forall a b c, R a b -> R a c -> b = c.

Definition irred a : Prop := forall b, ~(R a b).

End Star.

Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Language Infra SubDis.

(* ============ subtype basics ============ *)

Lemma sub_refl: forall A, sub A A.
Proof.
  induction A; eauto using sub, sandl, sandr.
  (* and *) apply sand; [apply sandl | apply sandr]; assumption.
Qed.

(* A computable "gord witness" inside a type *)
Fixpoint gordpart (A:typ) : option typ :=
  match A with
  | int => Some int
  | top => None
  | and A1 A2 => match gordpart A1 with Some C => Some C | None => gordpart A2 end
  | rcd n B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (rcd n C) | None => None end
  | arr A1 B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (arr A1 C) | None => None end
  end.

Lemma gordpart_gord: forall A C, gordpart A = Some C -> gord C.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl; intros C H; try discriminate.
  - inversion H; subst. constructor.
  - (* and *) destruct (gordpart A1) as [C1|] eqn:E; [inversion H; subst; apply IHA1; auto | apply IHA2; auto].
  - (* rcd *) destruct (gordpart A) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate. inversion H; subst. constructor. apply IHA; auto.
  - (* arr *) destruct (gordpart A2) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate. inversion H; subst. constructor. apply IHA2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_none_toplike: forall A, gordpart A = None -> toplike A.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl; intros H; try discriminate; try constructor.
  - (* and *) destruct (gordpart A1) as [C1|] eqn:E.
    + discriminate.
    + apply TL_and; [apply IHA1; auto | apply IHA2; auto].
  - (* rcd *) destruct (gordpart A) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    apply TL_rcd. apply IHA; auto.
  - (* arr *) destruct (gordpart A2) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    apply TL_arr. apply IHA2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_some: forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists C, gordpart A = Some C.
Proof.
  intros A H. destruct (gordpart A) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C; auto.
  - exfalso; apply H; apply gordpart_none_toplike; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_gordpart: forall A D C, sub A D -> gordpart D = Some C -> sub A C.
Proof.
  intros A D C HAD. revert C.
  induction HAD; simpl; intros C' HC.
  - (* sint *) inversion HC; subst. apply sint.
  - (* stop *) discriminate.
  - (* sand *) destruct (gordpart B) as [C1|] eqn:E.
    + inversion HC; subst. apply IHHAD1; auto.
    + apply IHHAD2; auto.
  - (* sandl *) apply sandl. apply IHHAD; auto.
  - (* sandr *) apply sandr. apply IHHAD; auto.
  - (* srcd *) destruct (gordpart B) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    inversion HC; subst. apply srcd. apply IHHAD; auto.
  - (* sarr *) destruct (gordpart D) as [C1|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    inversion HC; subst. apply sarr with (C:=C); auto.
Qed.

Lemma gord_of_nontoplike: forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists C, gord C /\ sub A C.
Proof.
  intros A H. destruct (gordpart_some A H) as [C E].
  exists C; split; [apply gordpart_gord; auto | apply sub_gordpart with (D:=A); auto using sub_refl].
Qed.

Lemma sub2_gord: forall A B D,
  sub A D -> sub B D -> ~ toplike D ->
  exists C, gord C /\ sub A C /\ sub B C.
Proof.
  intros A B D HA HB Hnt.
  destruct (gordpart_some D Hnt) as [C E].
  exists C; split; [apply gordpart_gord; auto|].
  split; eapply sub_gordpart; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Language Infra SubDis.

(* ============ subtype basics ============ *)

Lemma sub_refl: forall A, sub A A.
Proof.
  induction A; eauto using sub, sandl, sandr.
Qed.

(* A computable "gord witness" inside a type *)
Fixpoint gordpart (A:typ) : option typ :=
  match A with
  | int => Some int
  | top => None
  | and A1 A2 => match gordpart A1 with Some C => Some C | None => gordpart A2 end
  | rcd n B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (rcd n C) | None => None end
  | arr A1 B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (arr A1 C) | None => None end
  end.

Lemma gordpart_gord: forall A C, gordpart A = Some C -> gord C.
Proof.
  induction A; intros C; simpl.
  - intros H; inversion H; subst; constructor.
  - intros H; discriminate H.
  - (* and *)
    remember (gordpart A1) as D eqn:E. destruct D as [C1|].
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. inversion H; subst. apply IHA1; auto.
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. apply IHA2; auto.
  - (* rcd *)
    remember (gordpart A) as D eqn:E. destruct D as [C1|].
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. inversion H; subst. constructor. apply IHA; auto.
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - (* arr *)
    remember (gordpart A2) as D eqn:E. destruct D as [C1|].
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. inversion H; subst. constructor. apply IHA2; auto.
    + intros H. rewrite E in H. simpl in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_none_toplike: forall A, gordpart A = None -> toplike A.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.
  - intros H; discriminate H.
  - intros H; constructor.

(* ============ subtype basics ============ *)

Lemma sub_refl: forall A, sub A A.
Proof.
  induction A; eauto using sub, sandl, sandr.
Qed.

(* A computable "gord witness" inside a type *)
Fixpoint gordpart (A:typ) : option typ :=
  match A with
  | int => Some int
  | top => None
  | and A1 A2 => match gordpart A1 with Some C => Some C | None => gordpart A2 end
  | rcd n B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (rcd n C) | None => None end
  | arr A1 B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (arr A1 C) | None => None end
  end.

Lemma gordpart_gord_aux: forall A, match gordpart A with Some C => gord C | None => True end.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (gordpart A1) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart A) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart A2) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_gord: forall A C, gordpart A = Some C -> gord C.
Proof. intros A C E. pose proof (gordpart_gord_aux A). rewrite E in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma gordpart_none_aux: forall A, match gordpart A with Some _ => True | None => toplike A end.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.
  - exact I.
  - constructor.
  - destruct (gordpart A1) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + exact I.
    + apply TL_and; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart A) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + exact I.
    + apply TL_rcd; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart A2) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + exact I.
    + apply TL_arr; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_none_toplike: forall A, gordpart A = None -> toplike A.
Proof. intros A E. pose proof (gordpart_none_aux A). rewrite E in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma gordpart_some: forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists C, gordpart A = Some C.
Proof.
  intros A H. destruct (gordpart A) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C; auto.
  - exfalso; apply H; apply gordpart_none_toplike; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_gordpart_aux: forall A D, sub A D ->
  match gordpart D with Some C => sub A C | None => True end.
Proof.
  intros A D H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply sint.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (gordpart B) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *; auto.
  - apply sandl; auto.
  - apply sandr; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart B) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + apply srcd; auto.
    + exact I.
  - destruct (gordpart D) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + eapply sarr; eauto.
    + exact I.
Qed.

Lemma sub_gordpart: forall A D C, sub A D -> gordpart D = Some C -> sub A C.
Proof. intros A D C H E. pose proof (sub_gordpart_aux A D H). rewrite E in H0. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma gord_of_nontoplike: forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists C, gord C /\ sub A C.
Proof.
  intros A H. destruct (gordpart_some A H) as [C E].
  exists C; split; [apply gordpart_gord; auto | apply sub_gordpart with (D:=A); auto using sub_refl].

  destruct (gordpart_some D Hnt) as [C E].
  exists C; split; [apply gordpart_gord; auto|].
  split; eapply sub_gordpart; eauto.
Qed.

(* ============ subtype basics ============ *)

Lemma sub_refl: forall A, sub A A.
Proof.
  induction A; eauto using sub, sandl, sandr.
Qed.

(* A computable "gord witness" inside a type *)
Fixpoint gordpart (A:typ) : option typ :=
  match A with
  | int => Some int
  | top => None
  | and A1 A2 => match gordpart A1 with Some C => Some C | None => gordpart A2 end
  | rcd n B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (rcd n C) | None => None end
  | arr A1 B => match gordpart B with Some C => Some (arr A1 C) | None => None end
  end.

Lemma gordpart_gord_aux: forall A, match gordpart A with Some C => gord C | None => True end.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.
  - constructor.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (gordpart A1) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *; auto.
  - destruct (gordpart A) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + constructor; auto.
    + exact I.
  - destruct (gordpart A2) as [C1|] eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + constructor; auto.
    + exact I.
Qed.

Lemma gordpart_gord: forall A C, gordpart A = Some C -> gord C.
Proof. intros A C E. pose proof (gordpart_gord_aux A). rewrite E in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma gordpart_none_aux: forall A, match gordpart A with Some _ => True | None => toplike A end.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.

(* ============ disjointness helpers ============ *)
Lemma disjoint_sym: forall A B, disjoint A B -> disjoint B A.
Proof.
  intros A B H [C [Hg [H1 H2]]]. apply H. exists C; auto.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_and_l: forall A B C, disjoint (and A B) C -> disjoint A C.
Proof.
  intros A B C H [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. apply H.
  exists D; split; [auto|]. split; [apply sandl; auto|auto].
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_and_r: forall A B C, disjoint (and A B) C -> disjoint B C.
Proof.
  intros A B C H [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. apply H.
  exists D; split; [auto|]. split; [apply sandr; auto|auto].
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_rcd: forall n A B, disjoint (rcd n A) (rcd n B) -> disjoint A B.
Proof.
  intros n A B H [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. apply H.
  exists (rcd n D); split; [constructor; auto|]. split; apply srcd; auto.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_to_and_l: forall A B C, disjoint A (and B C) -> disjoint A B.
Proof.
  intros A B C H. apply disjoint_sym in H. apply disjoint_sym.
  apply disjoint_and_l in H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_to_and_r: forall A B C, disjoint A (and B C) -> disjoint A C.
Proof.
  intros A B C H. apply disjoint_sym in H. apply disjoint_sym.
  apply disjoint_and_r in H. auto.
Qed.

(* ============ typing inversion for values ============ *)
Lemma rec_inf_ty: forall G n w A, has_type G (rec n w) inf A ->
  exists A0, A = rcd n A0 /\ has_type G w inf A0.
Proof. intros G n w A H. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma merge_inf_comp: forall G a1 a2 A, has_type G (merge a1 a2) inf A ->
  exists A1 A2 G', A = and A1 A2 /\ has_type G a1 inf A1 /\ has_type G' a2 inf A2.
Proof. intros G a1 a2 A H. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma box_inf_ty: forall G e1 fm e Aa Ba A,
  has_type G (box e1 (ann (lam fm e) (arr Aa Ba))) inf A ->
  A = arr Aa Ba /\ exists B, has_type G e1 inf B.
Proof.
  intros G e1 fm e Aa Ba A H. inversion H; subst.
  inversion H3; subst. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma merge_typing_sub: forall G a b m T, has_type G (merge a b) m T ->
  exists A1 A2 Ge, has_type G a inf A1 /\ has_type Ge b inf A2.
Proof.
  intros G a b m T H. destruct m.
  - apply merge_inf_comp in H. exact H.
  - inversion H; subst.
    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (merge _ _) inf _ |- _ => apply merge_inf_comp in H0; exact H0 end.
Qed.

Lemma rec_typing_sub: forall G n e m T, has_type G (rec n e) m T ->
  exists A0, has_type G e inf A0.
Proof.
  intros G n e m T H. destruct m.
  - destruct (rec_inf_ty G n e T H) as (A0 & _ & Ht). eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (rec _ _) inf _ |- _ => destruct (rec_inf_ty _ _ _ _ H0) as (A0 & _ & Ht); eauto end.
Qed.

Lemma proj_typing_sub: forall G e n m T, has_type G (proj e n) m T ->
  exists A0, has_type G e inf (rcd n A0).
Proof.
  intros G e n m T H. destruct m.
  - inversion H; subst; eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (proj _ _) inf _ |- _ => inversion H0; subst; eauto end.
Qed.

Lemma app_typing_sub: forall G f a m T, has_type G (app f a) m T ->
  exists A B, has_type G f inf (arr A B) /\ has_type G a chk A.
Proof.
  intros G f a m T H. destruct m.
  - inversion H; subst; eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (app _ _) inf _ |- _ => inversion H0; subst; eauto end.
Qed.

Lemma box_typing_sub: forall G e1 e2 m T, has_type G (box e1 e2) m T ->
  exists B A', has_type G e1 inf B /\ has_type B e2 inf A'.
Proof.
  intros G e1 e2 m T H. destruct m.
  - inversion H; subst; eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (box _ _) inf _ |- _ => inversion H0; subst; eauto end.
Qed.

Lemma chk_inf: forall G e T, has_type G e chk T -> exists A, has_type G e inf A.
Proof. intros G e T H. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ann_chk_or_lam: forall G e t m T, has_type G (ann e t) m T ->
  has_type G e chk t \/ (exists fm eb Aa Ba, e = lam fm eb /\ t = arr Aa Ba).

    match goal with H0 : has_type _ (ann _ _) inf _ |- _ => apply ann_chk_or_lam with (m:=inf) (T:=_) in H0 end.
    exact H0.
Qed.
